description: Verified: the rendered DuckDB SQL for Q71 is ORDER BY "ext_price" DESC NULLS FIRST, "i_brand_id" (probe: SQL first key None vs DataFrame 3023.76), and Q76's ORDER BY equals its GROUP BY keys so ties are impossible (probe shows a NULL in the last key).
